report.pixelOrder: original sample-fastest, line-next; calibrated IR band k = original band k+96
report.reconstructedAdc: signed original core DN + original per-band/per-line BACKGROUND suffix
report.adcPolicy: Withhold ADC codes <0 and >=4095 plus original specials/invalid backgrounds; no C brightness threshold

filterDependencies.derivation: Minkowski sum: radius 2 for 5x5 noise classification plus radius 1 for 3x3 replacement
filterDependencies.interpretation: Possible source dependency; not a reconstruction of which pixels were replaced

report.limits: Does not recover lost saturation, undo archive filtering, detect every noise defect, or establish absolute calibration/pointing.
